teaser: One morning you are first in line, coat still cold, certain of what you want before the doors open. Another morning you are near the back, counting heads, already worried someone behind you won't get what they need. Life path 1 and ENFJ meet in that gap between wanting to go first and wanting everyone to arrive together. The 1 asks for a life built around your own direction; ENFJ asks you to hold the people walking alongside that direction. Neither drops away easily here. You carry both, most days without noticing the weight.
excerpt: Six in the morning, the gate still half asleep, and you have already checked the departure board twice and told a stranger which way to go.
